prepared_by: Claude (claude-opus-5-5) consolidation of the Codex and Claude drafts
scope: Discovery-centered union of both drafts. Credit pools are provisional and can exceed three; agents must select a coherent award of no more than three people in total. No ranking, probabilities or nominator counts are implied.
limitations: Recipient pools are evidence-informed starting points, not exhaustive priority judgments.

Living status was checked against Wikidata and Wikipedia for every pooled name on 2026-10-03, but many younger researchers have no registry entry; absence of a death record is not proof of living status. Recheck shortlisted recipients before final selection.
Claude-only entries cite Wikipedia overviews rather than primary or award sources; Codex entries keep their original sources.
Prior laureates can appear in a pool for a distinct achievement and are marked in prior_award_flags; already rewarded achievements need explicit overlap review.
Some entries are cross-category (optogenetics, chaperones, quorum sensing) or overlap the Medicine list; this is intentional coverage.
Committee coauthorship flags (zeolites, nanowires) need handling before simulation dispatch.
The union was trimmed to a simulation-sized list; trimmed_entries records each removed discovery and the reason.

Claude added Weitao Yang and Donald Truhlar as alternative functional-development credit.
candidates.review_decision: Merged shared discovery; Codex scope and sources retained; Claude names added to the pool.
